Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm, San Francisco’s largest urban farm, faced a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ran out. The farm had paused paid apprenticeships, reduced staff hours and was fundraising $200,000 to stay afloat. It produces more than 30,000 pounds of free produce annually, helping feed about 700 families each week.
